840	and spirit

841	is the opposite of matter. If you notice, I gave

842	a whole lesson on this, on what I called

843	the moral dilemma, matter and spirit. But notice,

844	look here at the letters, you can see it

845	right before your eyes. Chomer has four

846	letters. If we drop the mem, we get the letters chet-vav-resh,

847	in this order, in the word chomer.

848	Those exact same letters, only in reverse order, give

849	the word ruach.

850	Chet-resh… [snoring sounds]

851	In the word chomer, in this order, first chet, then vav,

852	then resh. The same letters, only reversed: first resh,

853	then vav, then chet. That is ruach.

854	Matter is limited in place and in time. What makes matter

855	a child of death is that it reaches its point of reset

856	and decay when it finishes the time it floats

857	on the time scale. That is why matter is a child of death.

858	Spirit is simply the opposite of matter. And matter

859	is a child of death. Spirit is its daughter,

860	it is eternal.

861	What does the mitzvah do? Whoever understands this, whoever understands

862	what I am saying now,

863	will run to do another mitzvah, and another, and another

864	mitzvah, and will understand what we usually wish

865	one another.

866	"May you merit mitzvot."

867	Why is it such a great privilege? Why is it such

868	an immense thing to do a mitzvah? I will tell you why.

869	To do a mitzvah

870	is to bring about the resurrection of the dead.

871	Let us explain.

872	Doing a mitzvah means that you yourself become

873	one who revives the dead. But not other dead people.

874	You revive the dead one within yourself.

875	What is the dead one within yourself?

876	The dead one within yourself is the body.

877	Each and every one of us has a soul. The soul does not

878	die and cannot die.

879	The eternal soul.
